title: MapleStory Idle RPG Artifacts Guide
author: MapleStory Idle RPG Wiki contributors
summary: An artifact reference covering the Guide Quest unlock, Artifact Chests, rarity and upgrade values, equipped special effects, and content-specific selection.

sections.title: Unlock and acquisition
items: Artifacts unlock through Guide Quest progression.
Artifact Chests are the main acquisition path after the system opens.

sections.title: Evaluation
items: Separate always-on stats from conditional equipped effects.
Value an effect against the content where its condition can actually trigger.

sections.title: Upgrade planning
items: Compare duplicate and upgrade value before spending limited materials.
Keep separate boss, farming, and competitive configurations when appropriate.

notes: Artifact lists and values are community-maintained and may change with patches.
prerequisites: Artifact system unlocked through Guide Quest progression
steps: Match conditions to the target content.
Upgrade only after comparing marginal gains.
